A hauler must land one oak timber on the east wharf with a quartz timing chip whose 12-second bench run stays between 11.92 and 12.08 seconds. At 05:40 the clerk photographs the end-grain saw-mark and matches that hash to the chip's sealed serial before the hook moves. A second chip, drift past 80 milliseconds, or a mismatched saw-mark burns the 36.5 POA bond and keeps that berth dark for four shifts.
